title: Workload Cert Lab
summary: X.509/SPIFFE-style workload identity: a trust-domain root CA signs short-lived SVID certificates; a mutual-TLS handshake walkthrough with a break-it pane.

cards.title: Trust domain root CA
cards.body: The root CA for {{cast.trustDomain}} is the only trust anchor this verifier accepts. Trust comes from configuration, not from the name.

cards.title: SVID (workload certificate)
cards.body: A short-lived EC P-256 certificate whose SAN carries the SPIFFE URI {{cast.svid}}. Same path under another domain is a different identity.

cards.title: Mutual TLS
cards.body: Both sides present a certificate and both verify against the same root. The server then authorizes the call on the client's SAN URI.

cards.title: Short-lived + rotation
cards.body: Certificates expire in minutes-to-hours, so a stolen one dies fast; the platform re-issues automatically (SPIRE-style agent).

cards.title: Break it on purpose
cards.body: Foreign-domain cert (SAN not in {{cast.trustDomain}}), expired SVID, tampered bytes — each shows the exact refusal.
